5: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...
261: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.

U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon / President Grant
773: Tough narcotics detective 'Popeye' Doyle is in hot pursuit of a suave French drug dealer who may be the key to a huge heroin-smuggling operation.
Doyle is bad news—but a good cop.

In the opening of the movie, Mikael Blomkvist, a middle-aged publisher for the magazine Millennium, loses a libel case brought by corrupt Swedish industrialist Hans-Erik Wennerström. Nevertheless, he is hired by Henrik Vanger in order to solve a cold case, the disappearance of Vanger's niece
Based on the Worldwide Best Seller

Deep their love! Great the risk!

A quiet little town not far from here.

How many times can you die for love?

Making love was easy...being in love difficult.
2821: When a Hollywood star mysteriously disappears in the middle of filming, the studio sends their fixer to get him back.

Calvin Fuller is about to break curfew...by 1500 years.

A true story of survival... declassified.

Knowledge can be a deadly thing.

The war is eternal. His mission is just the beginning.

It's hard out here for a geek.

She was made for love... and tragedy.

Today is better the second time around.

There is a world hidden within our own.

If you're hoping for the perfect family don't hold your breath.

Stake Your Claim To The Musical Goldmine of '69!

World in panic! Cities in flames!

They ran away from everything but each other.

Old Evil is coming to collect the bride.

What Hollywood didn't tell you about one of the world's most secretive religions

Their dramatic story can now be told!

Get ready for one mother of a road trip.

Beat Down Dude (segment "D is for Dogfight")

Get ready for the ultimate challenge!

Heart-Warming Romance . . . Ripped from the Heart!

One of the most controversial films ever made.

World beware. The wizard is coming.

AT LAST IT'S ON THE SCREEN! Greater than the Stage Show!

17157: Multiple lives intersect in the aftermath of the violent mugging of a Columbia University philosophy professor.
Who we don't know can save us

New Horrors! Mad Science Spawns Evil Fiends! ... Taking form before your horrified eyes!

Only one lead character, The one who wins takes the spot.
18693: Hot Bot is the hilarious journey of two sexually repressed and unpopular teenage geeks who accidentally discover a life-like super-model sex bot.

The most savage film in history!

It Takes An Outsider To See The Truth Inside.

20229: A former bank robber is released after 10 years in prison. He gets help from a social-worker, but gets harassed by an old cop from his past.
20485: An artificial Intelligence from far into the future arrives to immediately cleanse the human species of millions of humans who are harmful to other humans.
20741: Six complete strangers with widely varying personalities are involuntarily placed in an endless maze of interlocking cube-shaped rooms containing deadly traps.

Inari enters the Swamp Soccer tournament, where to her horror she finds out her ex Little Mikko is also competing.

THE PICTURE THAT TOUCHES NEW HEIGHTS OF EMOTION

Further, Catalina discloses that the spirit of Agata is trapped between the worlds of the living and the dead.

All the laughs... Half the calories.

24581: Monk steps out of retirement as his stepdaughter's wedding turns tragic when her fiancé dies in a bungee jumping accident.
It's a different world. He fits in perfectly.

Discover the most hidden secrets in Marta's diary.

Grim mystery to hold you breathless!

Michael is drawn into a world of hard beats, brotherhood and drugs. When Danny's drug business reaches international proportions, the brothers must fight for their lives.
28165: Aaditya  is an impulsive individual who takes decisions spontaneously and is unafraid to speak his mind. The love of his life Varsha is his extreme opposite — she chooses not to let her emotions control her actions or words. Will these two differing individuals ever make their relationship work?
28421: A celebrity journalist and renowned womanizer starts to rethink his life choices after he falls for a mysterious model who leads a double life.

29189: When Edward Creighton leads the construction of the Western Union to unite East with West, he hires a Western reformed outlaw and a tenderfoot Eastern surveyor.  Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in partnership with Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation in 2000.

When it comes to Beauty Queens - It's 'Carry On' and Bust!
29957: Stan and Ollie work in a horn factory. Ollie starts having violent fits every time he hears a horn. His doctor prescribes a restful sea voyage. Mayhem ensues.
They'll Scuttle Your Blues To the Bottom of the Sea!
30213: A group of unlikely companions receive a radio call leading to a deserted house with a grisly past.
We dare you to go inside...
30469: In 1937, amidst Stalin's Great Terror, a newly appointed prosecutor for the USSR is made aware of alleged corruption in the Secret Police, and takes it upon himself to investigate.

Do you have the courage to spend 83 minutes in the Tower of London?

From that day on, he sets on a personal crusade for justice.
31493: A romantic drama that charts the lives of three women from different backgrounds, forever changed when they emigrate to New Zealand as war brides.
A forbidden love. An impossible choice. A secret past.

Love without regrets, live life to the fullest.

Before Scooby-Doo these B.F.F.s had a clue.

33285: Three sideshow performers form a conspiracy known as 'The Unholy Three' – a ventriloquist, midget, and strongman working together to commit a series of robberies.
A Mystery Thriller of a Giant, a Ventriloquist and a Dwarf

Presidium of the National Council employee
34309: Without a family, penniless and separated from her sister, a beautiful chaste woman will have to cope with an endless parade of villains, perverts and degenerates who will claim not only her treasured virtue but also her life.
An erotic fantasy horror from the tortured pen of The Marquis de Sade.

Three boys wanted to be like their hero, Harry Spikes. They got their wish. Soon they were worth a fortune. DEAD or ALIVE.

How many lives are you willing to sacrifice?

His True Shocking Story...Filmed with Bullet Force!
35845: A true love story that spans a lifetime but eventually results in a painful loss of love. Jan is the daughter of an overly protective militant father, but that doesn't stop her from falling love with Steve, a young GI in the Air Force.

The story of a man apart... who brought faith to a youth, love to a woman, justice to a land!

A broken youth won't rest alone. Memories are beyond your imagination.
Young Jung Jong-suk / Female Karaoke Employee (voice)
37125: We all learned in schools that the WWI began with the assasination of Franz Ferdinand done by a young Bosnian Gavrilo Princip. In fact, the war was brewing much longer.

Meanwhile, the horrifying secret hidden behind the clay doll begins to surface.
37893: Five strangers awaken to find themselves trapped aboard an alien spaceship that seems to be harnessing their terror to power the ship. They begin to understand that these species have been abducting humans for decades and possibly centuries.

Just as he thought stability and prosperity are within reach, a new era of greed and riches takes him into a new battlefield of corruption.
38405: Piano teacher Roya (Mahnaz Afshar) realizes that her marriage to Ali is in a deadlock when she discovers some of her husband's secrets. In the meantime she meets a young musician (Saber Abar) and has to make a painful choice.

38917: An episodic film about the inhabitants of Kersko, their hardships and their joys, most prominently hunting. A lyrical and humorous adaptation of writings by Bohumil Hrabal.
39173: Now in his fifties, Vagn leads a solitary life and plays football with a group of similarly aged men, some even older. A Nordic road movie taking in a whole series of comic, serious and, above all, well-written scenarios.
39429: The idyllic and secluded Finnish archipelago. The pandemic soars across the world. Elli’s world trembles as her husband’s old friend arrives at the island.
39685: Thirty-five years in the life of Max, his best friend Sal and a woman they both adore, Lyla. The trio stumble through mandatory but seemingly unfulfilling entanglements, at weddings, funerals, hospitals, eateries, divorce courts and the tool shed. A deadpan fable about time sneaking up on and swerving right around us.
Girl at the Birthday Party (as Tabyana Ford)
39941: After his cattle rancher boss dies, right-hand man Pike is given the job of returning $86,000 to some families who live across the border in Sonora, Mexico. Honest Pike is joined on the trip through the wilderness by a dishonest gambler named Tyree.
It Rides With The Great Westerns
40197: Seung-ryong owns a small toast shop, who is sick from taking in briquette gas in the past after his parents died. One day, his first love comes back to Korea, and they become close. However, he finds out that his little sister is sick.

40709: Tale of Suku, who fakes insanity to escape the law. While faking insanity, he falls in love.
40965: A pregnant woman, who is taking care of her son with development problems, is at her breaking point when a caregiver from the Philippines steps into her life. Diana suspects that she’s using voodoo against her after the quick improvements of her son.
No one will save her from his child
41221: Three small-time criminals finally get the chance to climb the ladder - but manages to mess it all up in royal manners....
41477: Realize that everything connects to everything else.
41733: Abandoned in the barren wasteland of Kyoto, a savage, enraged orphan does whatever it takes to survive in the wild. When he crosses paths with civilization, he must learn to tame the beast within.
Born A Beast, To Be Human

Home is where the hugs are.
42501: Nina, an OB-GYN, faces accusations after a newborn's death. Her life undergoes scrutiny during investigation. She persists in her medical duties, determined to provide care others hesitate to offer, despite the risks.

How far will a family go to bury the truth?
43269: The story of Zeinal, a man who after 20 years of being a POW, tries to clear up his past.
43525: Jade is a waitress who leaves the greasy-diner business for the excitement of the carnival. She quickly discovers that she despises freaks and human oddities.
In the Corridors of Every Woman's Soul There Lurks a...

A young girl named Alice and the Care Bears travel together into the whimsical land of the Mad Hatter and the Cheshire Cat. In this magical story about friendship and self-esteem, they try to thwart an evil wizard's attempt to become the King of Wonderland.

Fara Diogomay the Elder Ceddo / Ousmane

Louise must ultimately choose which man she wants.
M-G-M's Magnificent Drama of Music and Romance

The true story of Maria Schneider behind the making of Last Tango in Paris.

Hoog’s arch-nemesis, the homicidal femme Lio Sha, murdered Naela on the very grounds of Hoog’s estate, prompting him to swear revenge upon her and her criminal organization, the Spiders. It's Never Too Late To Grow A Tail

After the arrival of her son Dragos, everything seems to have fallen perfectly into place. When the process of getting a green card veers unexpectedly off course, however, Mara is faced with abuses of power on every level and forced to answer a dark question about herself – how far would you go to get what you want?

But what she doesn't know is that Marco, the man who sabotaged her parents' plane, is on his way to Nantucket to set another terrifying scheme into motion. Can she uncover his dark secret and gather her wits to stop him in time?

He's starts investigating which eventually hunts down his past and brings chaos in his life. How Satya solved the mystery surrounding him forms the rest of the story.

A ROMANCE OF THE GREAT WAR

When your best option is a bad choice.

They find that some type of disaster has de-populated the Idaho region and, by implication, the nation or perhaps the world.
The future is a great place to visit.....

49157: A new doctor from Moscow arrives at a provincial mental institution. Obsessed with the past. Condemned to repeat it.
49925: In the first episode, Quirino tries to conquer co-worker Gabriella. In the second episode, Prof. Beozi ends up in a raid of the police in a local for homosexuals when trying to avoid a scandal. In the third episode, Guglielmo passes all tests in order to become reader of the television news brilliantly, although the commission works with all subtleness's to exclude him.
50181: Owing to a genetic mix-up involving stem cell research, the recently founded company Infinity Baby is able to offer a service for aspiring parents who never want to leave the baby bubble — infants that do not age.
50437: In a claustrophobic neighborhood where gossip and violence police people's behavior, the lives of residents intertwine and collide as some try to maintain social norms while others try to break them.
Behind closed doors, neighbours hide secrets.

In This Deadly Game... He Could Lose Only Once!
51205: Determined to rob a goldsmith, three young robbers break into his country house. The man and his wife turn out to be less defenseless than they seem.
51461: Poucet is a kid from a family of numerous children. The parents, too poor to feed them, decide to abandon them in the forest. Their, the brothers try to find their way out making fantastic encounters. This film is based on the French fairy tale "Le petit poucet" by Charles Perrault.
le soldat à la jambe de fer
51973: The Philippines, 1972. Mysterious things are happening in a remote barrio. Wails are heard from the forest, cows are hacked to death, a man is found bleeding to death at the crossroad, and houses are burned. Ferdinand E. Marcos announces Proclamation No. 1081, putting the entire country under Martial Law.
